_comment: Parasite (2019) recap skeleton. 20 units covering 28 beats. Register B (Medium). Hook U01 = viral cold-open teasing the class-parasite premise WITHOUT the bunker twist (twist-hold). Climax units U17-U18 use G4 restraint (descriptive, not over-dramatized violence). U20 outro preserves the ending ambiguity (Ki-woo's letter as maybe-dream - Joker U19/U20 pattern). Target ~2100 words / ~12 min at the calibrated Andrew +22% rate (3.5 w/s). must_cover lists the beat numbers each unit covers.

units.label: Hook - two families, one house
units.why: Viral cold-open: a poor family cons its way into a rich family's home, one job at a time. Tease the class-parasite premise + a question hook + channel intro. NO bunker/Geun-sae reveal, NO ending. All hook lines narrative_jump=true.

units.label: The Kims in the semi-basement
units.why: Establish the poor Kim family: phone-hunting for wifi, folding pizza boxes, fumigation gas - life at the bottom.

units.label: Min and the scholar's rock
units.why: Ki-woo's friend Min gives the lucky 'scholar's rock' and hands off the tutoring job at the rich Parks' house - the door opens.

units.label: Into the Park house
units.why: Ki-woo ascends to the modernist Park house, becomes 'Kevin' the tutor, charms Mrs Park and Da-hye.

units.label: Con #2 - Jessica
units.why: Ki-woo plants his sister Ki-jung as the elite art therapist 'Jessica' for Da-song; she dazzles with invented jargon.

units.label: Cons #3 and #4 - the takeover
units.why: The underwear ruse ousts the driver so Ki-taek takes the wheel; the peach-allergy / fake-TB scheme ousts the loyal housekeeper Moon-gwang. All four Kims now embedded under false identities.

units.label: The house to themselves
units.why: The Parks leave for a camping trip; the Kims sprawl through the empty mansion, drinking, pretending it is theirs - the class fantasy.

units.label: The doorbell
units.why: Late at night the ousted housekeeper Moon-gwang returns, begging to fetch something from the basement.

units.label: The hidden door
units.why: TWIST PIVOT. Moon-gwang opens a concealed door behind the shelving, revealing a stairwell descending underground. Tag the moment; let the reveal land.

units.label: The man in the bunker
units.why: Geun-sae, Moon-gwang's husband, has hidden in a secret bunker for years, living off the Parks unseen - a second parasite family already inside the house.

units.label: Two families collide
units.why: The poor families discover each other; Moon-gwang films the Kims and threatens to expose them - mutual blackmail, the floor dropping out.

units.label: The Parks come home
units.why: The rain ends the trip; the Parks return in minutes. The Kims subdue the couple back into the bunker, scramble to erase all trace, and hide under the table as the family settles above.

units.label: The smell that crosses the line
units.why: From under the table the Kims hear Mr Park describe Ki-taek's 'smell' crossing a line - the class insult that will detonate later. Cultural weight, no over-statement.

units.label: The descent and the flood
units.why: The Kims flee through the storm, down the city's stairways, back to their drowning semi-basement. The wordless vertical descent (SILENCE shot). The class chasm made literal.

units.label: Everything underwater
units.why: Sewage floods their home; their belongings are destroyed; the family sleeps among refugees in a gymnasium shelter.

units.label: The birthday party
units.why: The next day Mrs Park throws an impromptu garden party; the exhausted Kims are summoned to serve the rich at play.

units.label: The eruption
units.why: G4 RESTRAINT. Geun-sae bursts from the bunker and the party becomes a massacre - the stabbing in the garden, the chaos. Descriptive, not lurid.

units.label: The line is crossed
units.why: The smell line detonates: Ki-taek snaps and kills Mr Park, then vanishes. The aftermath - the family destroyed. Restraint.

units.label: After - the letter
units.why: Weeks later, a scarred Ki-woo and his mother are convicted; from a hillside he sees the house blink in Morse code and realises his father now hides in the bunker. He writes a letter promising to buy the house one day.

units.label: Outro - the plan
units.why: Preserve the ambiguity. The dreamed reunion cuts back to the same basement window and the snow - the plan that never fails because there is no plan. Thematic close + CTA. Do NOT state the dream as achievable.
